choukai_a1_01.title: Listening: Ordering Lunch
choukai_a1_01.audioText: Waiter: Hello! What would you like? Customer: I would like a sandwich, please. Waiter: Do you want something to drink? Customer: Yes, a glass of water, please. Waiter: Okay. Anything else? Customer: No, thank you.

choukai_a1_02.title: Listening: Meeting a Friend
choukai_a1_02.audioText: Maria: Hi, Tom! How are you? Tom: I am fine, thanks. And you? Maria: I am good. Are you busy tomorrow? Tom: No, I am free. Why? Maria: Let us go to the cinema at three o'clock. Tom: Sounds great! See you at two thirty at the station.

choukai_a2_01.title: Listening: Booking a Hotel
choukai_a2_01.audioText: Receptionist: Good evening. How can I help you? Guest: I would like to book a room for two nights, from Friday to Sunday. Receptionist: Of course. Would you prefer a room with a sea view? Guest: Yes, that would be lovely, but the price should not be too high. Receptionist: We have a double room for one hundred and twenty dollars per night. Guest: That sounds perfect. I will take it.

choukai_a2_02.title: Listening: Asking for Directions
choukai_a2_02.audioText: Tourist: Excuse me, is there a bank near here? Local: Yes, there is one on the corner of Green Street. Tourist: How do I get there? Local: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. It is next to a big pharmacy. Tourist: Thank you so much! Local: You are welcome.

choukai_b1_01.title: Listening: A Job Interview
choukai_b1_01.audioText: Interviewer: Can you tell me about your previous experience? Candidate: Certainly. For the last three years, I have worked as a sales assistant. I have learned to handle customers and to solve problems quickly. Interviewer: Why do you want to work for our company? Candidate: I have always admired your commitment to sustainability, and I would like to contribute to that goal.

choukai_b1_02.title: Listening: Planning a Community Event
choukai_b1_02.audioText: Anna: We should organise a street festival this summer. Ben: That is a great idea, but we need permission from the council first. Anna: I already contacted them, and they said the application must be submitted by the end of May. Ben: Then we should arrange a meeting next week to divide the tasks. Anna: Agreed. I will prepare the invitations, and you could ask local shops to donate prizes.
